title: Lower Field Audience & Infrastructure Role Atlas
purpose: Fill the middle layer between Farmer/Cow/Dog and the platform by distinguishing audience, archival, moderation, monetization and infrastructure roles that can reinforce, interrupt or transform a Farm relation.
core_thesis: A Farm does not need every participant to be a Farmer or Dog. Many systems persist because attention, memory, status and infrastructure are distributed across bystanders and supporting roles.

audience_roles.can_reinforce: adds attention/traffic and preserves audience demand even without posting
audience_roles.can_interrupt: can disengage, refuse redistribution or privately support correction
audience_roles.boundary: passivity is not identical to endorsement

audience_roles.function: laughs, likes, cheers, rewards, repeats or validates the local frame
audience_roles.can_interrupt: withdraw reward or reward correction/repair instead
audience_roles.research_bridge: cyberbullying bystander research distinguishes reinforcers from outsiders and defenders

audience_roles.function: helps with concrete tasks such as finding, clipping, reposting, tagging or contacting
audience_roles.can_interrupt: refuse invasive tasks, preserve provenance or redirect toward source-checking

audience_roles.function: supports the targeted person, corrects false claims, reports threats or helps restore boundaries
audience_roles.can_reinforce: poorly bounded defense can accidentally create more conflict content
audience_roles.can_interrupt: reduce harm, restore source distinction and provide exit support

audience_roles.function: converts live/ephemeral material into portable fragments
audience_roles.can_interrupt: retain context, timestamps and source links rather than optimizing humiliation

audience_roles.function: interprets another person's material for an audience
audience_roles.can_reinforce: adds narrative layers and monetizable recurrence
audience_roles.can_interrupt: scope commentary to issues, distinguish fact/allegation and stop when the issue ends

audience_roles.can_reinforce: makes dormant conflict cheap to reactivate
audience_roles.can_interrupt: preserve corrections, uncertainty, role expiry and closure as strongly as dramatic material

audience_roles.can_reinforce: rewards recurrence, escalation or target-centered programming
audience_roles.can_interrupt: reward independent creation, repair, de-escalation or non-target work

audience_roles.function: enforces local rules and sets boundaries
audience_roles.can_reinforce: selective enforcement can entrench local enemy/target roles
audience_roles.can_interrupt: apply transparent rules, appeals, proportional sanctions and closure

audience_roles.function: provides technical distribution, ranking, monetization, storage and identity systems
audience_roles.can_reinforce: recommendation, virality, monetization and persistence can lower cost of recurrence
audience_roles.can_interrupt: rate limits, moderation, privacy controls, account enforcement, friction, de-amplification and appeals

audience_roles.function: makes old material retrievable long after the event
audience_roles.can_interrupt: context, freshness markers, corrections and canonical-source preference can reduce stale-role dominance

audience_roles.can_reinforce: sensational repetition can reactivate a Farm
audience_roles.can_interrupt: source discipline, proportionality, victim privacy, right of reply and clear closure

audience_roles.function: a participant who changes from passive/reinforcing behavior toward defense, correction or disengagement
audience_roles.can_interrupt: demonstrates that roles are dynamic rather than castes

infrastructure_functions.attention: views, clicks, replies, shares, watch-time and searches tell participants/platforms what remains salient
infrastructure_functions.portability: clips, screenshots, quotes and mirrors let material travel across contexts
infrastructure_functions.memory: threads, wikis, archives and search make roles inheritable by newcomers
infrastructure_functions.status: recognition, insider knowledge, speed, discovery and provocation can function as non-monetary compensation
infrastructure_functions.money: ads, tips, subscriptions, memberships and sponsorships can turn recurrence into direct economic reward
infrastructure_functions.governance: moderation rules, appeals, bans, permissions and access structure define what the culture can reproduce
infrastructure_functions.algorithmic_distribution: ranking/recommendation can amplify material without any participant commanding the whole ecology
infrastructure_functions.friction: privacy settings, rate limits, moderation, source requirements and verification can slow or redirect recurrence

audience_feedback_loop: reinforcers reward / assistants help / outsiders watch
commentators and clippers make material portable
intervention_points: mark stale material and current-state changes
stop converting every reply into new content
reduce involuntary discoverability of private/sensitive material
make role expiry and closure searchable
shift funding and status toward independent work rather than target recurrence
research_boundaries: Cyberbullying bystander findings often come from adolescent samples; use the role structure as a comparator, not direct prevalence estimates for adult internet subcultures.
Audience attention is not automatically harassment.
Platform recommendation can amplify salience without proving intent to target a person.
A donor or viewer is not automatically responsible for every act done by creators they watch.
Archiving is not automatically farming; purpose, scope, correction and stopping conditions matter.
